/* =========================================
PROFESSIONAL RESEARCH WEBSITE
========================================= */

:root {
--research-blue: #12355b;
--research-light: #eef5fb;
--research-accent: #1b7f8c;
--research-dark: #17202a;
--research-text: #3f4b56;
}

/* ---------- General ---------- */

body {
font-family: "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
color: var(--research-text);
line-height: 1.7;
background: #ffffff;
}

h1,
h2,
h3 {
color: var(--research-dark);
font-weight: 700;
}

/* ---------- Navigation ---------- */

.navbar {
background: #ffffff !important;
border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e9ed;
padding: 12px 30px;
}

.navbar-brand {
color: var(--research-blue) !important;
font-weight: 700;
font-size: 1.25rem;
}

.navbar-nav .nav-link {
color: var(--research-dark) !important;
font-weight: 500;
margin-left: 12px;
}

.navbar-nav .nav-link:hover {
color: var(--research-accent) !important;
}

/* ---------- Hero Section ---------- */

.hero {
background: linear-gradient(
135deg,
#eef5fb 0%,
#ffffff 55%,
#e7f4f3 100%
);

padding: 100px 70px;
margin-bottom: 70px;
border-radius: 0 0 35px 35px;
}

.hero h1 {
font-size: 4rem;
color: var(--research-blue);
margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.hero h3 {
font-size: 1.35rem;
color: var(--research-accent);
font-weight: 500;
margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.hero p {
max-width: 800px;
font-size: 1.15rem;
}

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */

.btn-primary,
.btn-secondary {
display: inline-block;
padding: 12px 24px;
margin: 15px 8px 0 0;
border-radius: 8px;
text-decoration: none !important;
font-weight: 600;
transition: 0.25s ease;
}

.btn-primary {
background: var(--research-blue);
color: white !important;
}

.btn-primary:hover {
background: var(--research-accent);
transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.btn-secondary {
border: 2px solid var(--research-blue);
color: var(--research-blue) !important;
background: white;
}

.btn-secondary:hover {
background: var(--research-blue);
color: white !important;
}

/* ---------- Section Headings ---------- */

main h2 {
margin-top: 60px;
margin-bottom: 30px;
padding-bottom: 10px;
border-bottom: 3px solid var(--research-accent);
}

/* ---------- Research Cards ---------- */

.research-card {
background: #ffffff;
border: 1px solid #e2e7eb;
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 25px;
margin: 20px 0;
box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
transition: 0.25s ease;
}

.research-card:hover {
transform: translateY(-5px);
box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.10);
}

.research-card h3 {
color: var(--research-blue);
margin-top: 0;
}

/* ---------- Research Grid ---------- */

.g-col-lg-3 {
padding: 10px;
}

.g-col-lg-3 > div {
height: 100%;
background: var(--research-light);
border-radius: 15px;
padding: 25px;
border: 1px solid #dce8f0;
}

.g-col-lg-3 h3 {
color: var(--research-blue);
margin-top: 0;
}

/* ---------- Tables ---------- */

table {
width: 100%;
border-collapse: collapse;
margin: 25px 0;
}

th {
background: var(--research-blue);
color: white;
padding: 14px;
}

td {
padding: 13px;
border-bottom: 1px solid #e3e6e8;
}

tr:hover {
background: #f5f9fb;
}

/* ---------- Quote / Vision ---------- */

blockquote {
background: var(--research-light);
border-left: 5px solid var(--research-accent);
padding: 25px;
border-radius: 8px;
font-size: 1.15rem;
color: var(--research-blue);
}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */

.footer-note {
text-align: center;
margin-top: 80px;
padding: 30px;
border-top: 1px solid #e1e5e8;
color: #71808c;
}

/* ---------- Mobile ---------- */

@media (max-width: 768px) {

.hero {
padding: 60px 25px;
}

.hero h1 {
font-size: 2.7rem;
}

.hero h3 {
font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.navbar {
padding: 10px 15px;
}

main {
padding-left: 15px;
padding-right: 15px;
}
}
